title: Exodus: Crypto Bitcoin Wallet
meta_description: Secure, stake, & exchange Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, +100 more and store NFTs
full_description: The only crypto wallet you’ll ever need: Buy, exchange, stake, and earn interest on cryptocurrencies in the world's leading crypto and Bitcoin wallet.Exodus makes crypto trading easy with a built-in Bitcoin and altcoin exchange. Manage your favorite NFTs and digital currencies all in one secure wallet.Exodus was created to put you in control of your wealth.ONE CRYPTO WALLET FOR ALLManage the most popular cryptocurrencies in one app including Bitcoin BTC, Ethereum, Avalanche, XRP, Polkadot, Chainlink, Cardano, VeChain, Monero, EOS, and more. Scroll down for the full list of cryptocurrencies we support.OVER 100 SUPPORTED CRYPTO WALLETSManage the most popular cryptocurrency wallets all in one app including Bitcoin BTC wallet, Ethereum wallet, Avalanche wallet, XRP wallet, Polkadot wallet, Chainlink wallet, Cardano wallet, VeChain wallet, Monero wallet, EOS wallet, and more. Scroll down for the full list of cryptocurrencies we support.BUY, STAKE, EARN INTEREST, & TRADE CRYPTOBuy crypto, earn interest and exchange cryptocurrency in just a few taps using the in-app crypto exchange — all without having to sign up for an account.24/7 WORLD-CLASS SUPPORTOur support team is available to help 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Find us on Twitter @exodus_io or write to us at support@exodus.io.TRACK YOUR CRYPTO PORTFOLIOBring your crypto portfolio to life with stunning and intuitive charts that update in real-time. Each crypto wallet has its own chart. Easily export your activity in CSV format to assist with crypto taxes.SEND AND RECEIVE CRYPTOCURRENCIES AND NFTsNeed to send or receive Bitcoin, or simply store NFTs? Send and receive any of the 230+ supported blockchain assets or your favorite NFT with the touch of a button using text addresses or QR codes. Your global cash app is here.MULTIPLE DEVICE SYNCSync Exodus across multiple devices including desktop, web browser and Trezor hardware wallet – for extra convenience and enhanced security in a way that works for you.WORLD-CLASS DESIGN AND ENGINEERINGExodus brings you an experience that combines the best of design and engineering. Our team has experience designing experiences for the likes of Apple, BMW, Disney, Louis Vuitton, Microsoft, and Nike. Engineering-wise, we’ve published over 200 open-source libraries and written code in use by most Bitcoin and cryptocurrency software out there.MOST POPULAR CRYPTO WALLETS SUPPORTED:Bitcoin BTC Ethereum ETHSolana SOLAvalanche AVAX Ripple XRPMonero XMR Litecoin LTCABOUT EXODUSCreated in 2015, Exodus gives customers a way to depart the legacy system and join the crypto and Web3 revolution. Whether you are looking for a simple and easy to use Bitcoin wallet for beginners or a more advanced crypto wallet that supports multiple currencies and advanced features, Exodus covers all of your cryptocurrency wallet needs.Download Exodus for a luxury crypto and Bitcoin wallet experience unlike any other cryptocurrency wallet on the market.
